propositions: The completion verifier reads a stale pinned snapshot of the ticket store because materialize_tickets with fetch=False uses a local mirror of refs/heads/tickets that is arbitrarily behind origin/tickets, rather than pinning the live tracker HEAD.

The verifier receives an untrusted ticket context from the live store but calls show_ticket against the stale pinned snapshot, creating disagreement between the two halves of the gate and leading the model to cite false evidence (zero comments, wrong status).

A non-PASS verdict with zero findings is coerced to FAIL with a synthesized placeholder criterion (unspecified) instead of reporting that no usable verdict was obtainable, blocking closes without actionable diagnostics.

The fetch=False flag is threaded from close_precheck through resolve_gate_handle into materialize_tickets, skipping live store synchronization for the ticket store despite its documented purpose being reproducibility and signability of the current shared store, not a stale local copy.

Two blocked closes (wailsome-unsure-asianlion and fixable-angular-caribou) both exhibited staleness defects: the first with false verdict evidence, the second masquerading as budget starvation when evidence anchors were invisible to the stale-pinned verifier.
